rule: TypeSpec and JSON Schema/OpenAPI are independent peer authorities. Protobuf is a reviewed flattened projection. No representation wins a discrepancy automatically.

deltas.reason: TypeSpec uses a union alias over two model expressions while JSON Schema uses one closed object with if/then/else. Both must admit exactly the same success and error states.
The append-only Protobuf message cannot encode conditional field presence or status ranges. Every generated Protobuf adapter must run the shared semantic validator after decoding.
